The layout check reads the width of the text from the full lines of this first page, which holds no image. A width as wide as the text or wider leaves no room for the text beside the figure. The filter cannot know the text width, so Typst measures it while it lays out the page. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.
